After a fierce battle with Blackbeard pirate, Luffy lost and got captured.
Straw hat pirate scattered, Nami did everything to help her captain.
She went to a sky island.
She ate a devil fruit.
Nami gained the power to steal anything.

Now, a new goddess is born!

What will Nami do with the new power? You'll find out in this comic!
